Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Ben bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. Ben and Lily had great fun there. In fact, many locals still patronise the little bakery on the corner.
Last Monday, Ben and Lily went to the bakery. The bakery is one of the best places in the city. Ben plays football with Lily every Monday. Grandma keeps her sewing things in a wicker basket.
Lily is interested in reading. They took many photos at the tea house. Ben learned a lot about history. Dinner is ready.
Life is full of small surprises. The weather was rainy that day. Ben likes rainy days best.
